title: Potato Storage Warehouse — Orser Street, beside the Railroad
description: Storage warehouses sprang up to store the excess potatoes until the market's supply and demand were profitable enough to offset production costs. This warehouse was located on Orser Street beside the railroad for easy loading to outside markets.
